title: Attorney Associate
description:
Job Opening: Legal Associate Foreign Language Skills Qualification: LLB/LLM | Freshers Welcome
 Work Mode: 100% Work From Home
 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 Shift: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Job Description: We are looking for fresher law graduates with certification or proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Portuguese to join our legal team. The role involves litigation support and managed document review, primarily in English, with occasional review or translation of documents in the relevant foreign language. Key Requirements: LLB/LLM graduates; freshers are welcome to apply. Certification or proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Portuguese. Ability to read and write in the relevant foreign language; basic speaking skills are sufficient. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Strong attention to detail and analytical skills. Selection Process: HR Interview Assessment Legal Interview If you have a legal background and foreign language skills, we encourage you to apply!

Key Skills: Document Review,Managed Document Review,E-discovery,Documents,Management,Review
